One of the most overlooked parts of the AI buildout is that Ethernet switching is growing 49% annually versus 36% for AI servers as larger GPU clusters require increasingly powerful networking.

That’s great for $MRVL, $ALAB, $CRDO and $AVGO because every new generation of AI chips needs faster connections to move data between GPUs, memory and entire server racks.

$ANET is also interesting because it holds ~25% of AI Ethernet switching as hyperscalers are adopting Ethernet to connect massive AI clusters.

quoted.text:
Read this on fb and wanted to share. Absolutely incredible story of Kid Rock. 

In late 1993, twenty-two-year-old Robert James Ritchie opened his front door in Michigan to find his high school girlfriend, Kelley South Russell, had left their six-month-old son, Bobby Jr., and her two other children sitting on his porch steps before walking away.

Born on June 14, 1993, Robert James Ritchie Jr. arrived right as his father’s early music career collapsed. Jive Records had just dropped Kid Rock following the commercial failure of his debut album, leaving the young musician broke and scrambling to survive in the Detroit underground scene. After making sure Kelley’s other two children were safely placed with their maternal relatives, the twenty-two-year-old took his infant son inside and raised him alone.

With no money for a nanny, the unruly underground rapper had to grow up overnight. Inside a cramped apartment, he mixed formula, changed diapers, and rocked the baby to sleep, then used the quiet hours while Bobby Jr. napped to write songs and pack cassette tapes and CDs to sell out of the trunk of his car. Exhausted from sleepless nights, he played dingy Detroit-area bars and clubs for a few dozen dollars in cash just to keep diapers and milk in the house.
